failure_policy: CLARIFY on missing/unsupported essential inputs; REFUSED on policy/scope/conflict; unavailable status and unresolved effects CURRENT_STATUS_UNKNOWN. Persist terminal highwater before use refusal. At most8 ordered events/32 protocol requests, each task2 payload/8metadata/2accepted bodies/128KiB. A verified REVOKED/SUPERSEDED current-use refusal retains authentic terminal state and a fresh local BLOCKED_FAIL_CLOSED Root decision linked to the original request, failed active predicate and signed evidence. Confirmation uncertainty remains CURRENT_STATUS_UNKNOWN; unknown errors propagate.
compensation: NOT_APPLICABLE to single disposable all-or-none registry snapshot. No automatic rollback; uncertain native or filesystem outcome stops for saved receipt and independent readback. No cross-owner or power-loss guarantee.
